svg.title: Rabi oscillations
svg.desc: What this figure shows: A resonantly driven two-level system exchanges population coherently between basis states. Governing relation: P_e(t)=sin^2(Omega t/2). How to read it: Read time horizontally and excited-state population vertically. The repeated rise from zero toward one and return to zero is coherent population transfer under resonant driving; the oscillation period is fixed by the Rabi frequency Omega. Main takeaway: Coherent driving can reversibly transfer population between two quantum levels. Scientific status: Standard two-level coherent dynamics. This is a standard quantum-mechanics or quantum-information figure. It does not show that consciousness is quantum, that consciousness causes wave-function collapse, that quantum mechanics is incomplete, or that consciousness is an additional physical dimension.
